text:
ashwin: quick sketch — proposing a "tenant quarantine" layer in the prefix cache to smooth eviction oscillations for very hot tenants. idea: temporarily isolate a tenant's hot prefixes into a short-lived quarantine slab with a higher eviction hysteresis and controlled admission, then re-integrate after traffic cools. low-risk, tunable window.

lina: sounds interesting — what's the goal metric? fewer cross-tenant eviction flips?

dash: yep. primary goals: reduce eviction churn that causes cascading rehydrates and tail latency spikes, and limit spillover that penalizes other tenants. secondary: provide a signal for backpressure/fairness.

ashwin: operationally I imagine: when a tenant's eviction-rate or rehydrate-frequency crosses threshold X within Ys, we mark them Quarantined for Zs. Quarantined prefixes get: (1) boosted residency score, (2) capped prefetch concurrency, (3) admission token bucket so we don't let them monopolize fill bandwidth.

dave: rough pseudocode for the decision function:
```
if tenant.eviction_rate > E_THRESH && tenant.rehydrate_rate > R_THRESH:
    tenant.quarantine_expires = now + QUARANTINE_WINDOW
    tenant.quarantine_mode = true

// on eviction scoring path
score = base_score(usage)
if tenant.quarantine_mode:
    score += QUARANTINE_BOOST  // makes eviction less likely
    score = min(score, MAX_SCORE)
```

lina: curious about correctness: does this change any lease/ownership invariants? could we end up with two nodes thinking they own the same prefix because we delay eviction?

dash: good call. quarantine should live purely in the residency/eviction layer — do not extend lease time or change ownership tokens. ownership stays the same; quarantine only changes local eviction scoring and admission. that preserves single-source-of-truth for ownership while giving local grace.

sophia: so we avoid API churn. but we still need telemetry + traces to ensure we don't silently bias fairness metrics. what signals do we add?

ashwin: plan: emit events when tenant enters/exits quarantine, record prefill/admit rates, delta in eviction_count, and rehydrate-latency for quarantined prefixes vs baseline. add a gauge for "quarantine_active_tenants". also tag traces with `quarantine=true` so we can slice tail-latency.

dave: rollout plan: start as a read-only experiment metric (we compute who would be quarantined but don't apply changes) for N days; then enable on 5% of nodes, compare fairness_score and tail P95/P99 for impacted tenants. if we see regressions, back out.

sre-bot: experiment-note: tenant_quarantine read-only run computed ~18 candidate tenants in last 24h on cluster-prod-gpu-3. starting 5% pilot tomorrow 04:00 UTC.

lina: edge-case: hot tenants that are multi-tenant within a single customer account (many small prefixes) — the heuristic should consider aggregated tenant hotness not just single-prefix. we should ensure small hot prefixes don't get starved.

dash: agree — use both per-prefix hotness and tenant-level aggregate. preferentially quarantine at tenant-level (all that tenant's prefixes), but allow a per-prefix override when a single hotspot is tiny and noise-prone.

sophia: any interface change needed for ops? e.g., admin to force-quarantine a tenant or opt-out?

ashwin: add two admin knobs in console: force-enter and force-exit per-tenant, and an opt-out flag for tenants that want their own behavior (enterprise customers). keep those behind feature flag and RBAC.

dave: perf concern: quarantine_boost means some prefixes will stay longer in memory — need eviction budget accounting to avoid starving other tenants. propose a soft-credits system: quarantined tenants draw from a separate budget pool and we throttle new admits when pool depleted.

lina: agree. also we should simulate this in the offline cache simulator with real tenant traces before rollout. I'll file a short runbook and simulation job.

ashwin: action items:
- dave: add quarantine decision + scoring hooks (PR -> small prototyping branch)
- lina: run simulator + create metric dashboard (quarantine owners, fairness_score, tail-latency diff)
- sophia: add admin controls + RBAC draft for console
- ops: canary 5% nodes, graceful kill switch

ashwin: thanks — if nobody objects I'll open the prototype PR tomorrow and attach the simulator plan. :thumbsup:

sophia: +1 from me, please include unit tests for scoring path to assert no ownership change.

ashwin: noted — will add tests.

sre-bot: update: pilot started on cluster-prod-gpu-3 at 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z (coverage=5%). monitoring alerts: quarantine_active_tenants=1.
